description: Natural terracotta square tile in an 8x8 inch format from Pak Clay, shown in a living room setting. The compact square suits smaller rooms and can be laid straight or on the diagonal. Fired clay gives a warm, earthy colour for traditional and modern interiors. Clay is porous, so lay it on a sound base, protect it from standing water and ask your fixer about a breathable sealer. Shade varies between pieces, so order a little extra from one batch. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Multi Terra tile from Pak Clay, a terracotta piece for floors and walls where you want a little more tonal variety than a single flat colour. Fired clay gives a warm, natural look, and tone can differ from piece to piece, so check a sample in your own light before you decide. Clay is porous, so use a sound base and ask about a breathable sealer. Order a margin from one batch so shades blend. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Natural terracotta hexagon tile in a 6x6 inch format from Pak Clay. The six-sided shape fits together in a honeycomb pattern and gives floors, borders and wall features a traditional clay character. Fired clay has a warm, earthy colour that comes from the material, not paint. Hexagons need careful setting-out and extra pieces for edge cuts. Clay is porous, so ask about a breathable sealer and keep standing water off it. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.

Natural terracotta octagon tile in a 10x10 inch format from Pak Clay. The eight-sided shape is classically paired with small insert pieces to form a repeating pattern, giving verandahs, courtyards and living areas a traditional clay look. Fired clay has a warm, earthy colour that suits floors and walls. Clay is porous, so lay it on a sound base, plan the layout before fixing and ask about a breathable sealer. Colour varies naturally, so order a little extra. Request a free sample on WhatsApp and send your area, use and city for a dated written quote.
